title: Recipe and Scholarship
author: Elodie Pemberton
blurb: Ivo Sandoval, a coder whose anonymous account knows too much, has spent three years being so careful it hurts. Then the school's legendary ghost starts leaving notes addressed by name — in impossible ink — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must save the tradition that made the town, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
